build.beforeBuildCommand: cd ../mednarrate-admin && node -e "const u=process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL; if (!u || !u.startsWith('https://')) { console.error('Set NEXT_PUBLIC_API_BASE_URL to the production HTTPS API origin'); process.exit(1) }" && TAURI_ENV=true npm run build

security.csp: default-src 'none'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; connect-src 'self' https:; img-src 'self' data: https:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self' data:; frame-src 'none'; object-src 'none';
